name: Bournemouth lumbar quantitative fluoroscopy (Breen 2021)
what: weight-bearing and recumbent L2 to S1 flexion and extension cine of 127 subjects at 15 fps, 60 degrees at 6 degrees a second; only per-frame angles are public on OSF a27py, while the group's public OSF deposit z2jby holds preproc_224_wb_flex.zip, 1,492,963,815 bytes of weight-bearing flexion frames preprocessed to 224 by 224 pixels, as its name and the repository's sample frames (five vertebral boxes) show, with no licence stated (how_to_get); the full-resolution cine, recumbent and extension included, stays the letter's ask
level_truth: lumbar, if corner templates exist as they do for the cervical set
licence: not recorded (OSF a27py holds derived tables only; the image deposit OSF z2jby states no licence)
how_to_get: Part of request 1 above: write to the corresponding author of doi:10.3389/fbioe.2021.745837 for the L2-S1 cine behind osf.io/a27py.

A public deposit of part of this material exists: the group's OSF project z2jby (doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/Z2JBY, made 2023-02-15 by Samaratunga with A. Breen, A. Breen and Budka under MRC grant MR/X005372/1), three files in OSF Storage, read through OSF's API from the owner's computer on 2026-10-23: preproc_224_wb_flex.zip (1,492,963,815 bytes, 2023-02-20, sha256 b43de4c185dd751ed2e3e04d75e8eef10aa6c3e09bf4393accffbecd6805bb26, https://osf.io/download/xjt4f/), rn50-224-wb-flex-50ep-bs500.pth (383,648,577 bytes, 2023-02-21) and shape-rn50-224-wb-flex-38ep-bs500.pth (459,107,325 bytes, 2023-03-13), each downloadable with no account (a HEAD answered 200 with the same size). Its GitHub repository dsibournemouth/project-maid (GPL-3.0) says the zip is the image set its notebooks read and the two .pth files are the repository's own saved parameters, which this registry does not need; the paper is Samaratunga, Budka, Breen and Breen, Procedia Computer Science 2025, vol. 270, pp. 2291-2300 (doi:10.1016/j.procs.2025.09.350). The grant (UKRI Gateway to Research, read by the owner on 2026-10-23) ran from August 2022 to February 2023 under Professor Budka at Bournemouth's Faculty of Science and Technology, on the QF database Professor Breen's team had collected over years of earlier research, whose participants consented to future research use, with an independent sample from the Royal Hampshire County Hospital as a check. The page states no licence, so the promoter's rule (manifests/README.md) needs Bournemouth's grant first; Dr Branney is checking with the research department (2026-10-22) and the owner chose on 2026-10-23 not to chase him, so the deposit's terms are asked when he answers.

Once the grant is recorded as a granted step in the history, write manifests/bournemouth_lumbar_qf.json with the one image file (path raw/preproc_224_wb_flex.zip, the osf.io/download link, bytes and sha256 above, verified against OSF's file API) and set the record to fetching; the promoter installs it at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/bournemouth_lumbar_qf/raw (grid/README.md).
